title: Templates
storeTemplatesDesc: Pre-built storefront templates that connect to your products, orders, and payment systems.
apiKeyDesc: Use this API key to connect templates to your store data

editable.name: Modern Store
editable.description: Fully customizable storefront with a visual website builder — sections, colors, typography, media, and live preview.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: A polished, conversion-focused storefront — ready to publish. Homepage, catalog, product pages, cart, and checkout are designed for you and powered by your store data.

floral.name: Floral Atelier
floral.description: An ultra-premium flower boutique storefront — airy imagery, elegant typography, and full cart/checkout with Netopia, cash on delivery, home delivery, and locker pickup.

modes.demoHint: Sample photos, products & copy — show customers how the site can look.
modes.liveHint: Your real products, text, and checkout.

help.step1: 1. Copy your Store API Key from above
help.openTemplate: 2. Click "Open Template" to view the storefront
help.step3: 3. The template will automatically load your products, collections, and settings
help.step4: 4. Customers can browse products, add to cart, and complete purchases
help.step5: 5. All orders will appear in your Orders tab
help.tip: 💡 You can share the template URL with customers or embed it on your website

toast.premiumUrlCopied: Premium store URL copied — share it to publish
toast.floralUrlCopied: Floral store URL copied — share it to publish

builder.hubSubtitle: Design your storefront visually — edit sections, style your brand, preview instantly, and publish when you’re ready.
builder.hubCtaBody: Tap into the editor to customize your homepage, theme, and content blocks with a live preview.
builder.title: Home page
builder.publishedToast: Saved & live URL copied — share it with customers
builder.systemSectionHint: This section is powered by your catalog data. Hide it or style it from Theme.
builder.pagesHint: Home is fully editable in the builder. Product, cart, and checkout pages inherit your theme automatically.

catalog.productsHint: Product grid, collections, and reviews are built-in homepage sections — toggle them in the section list.
